context: Foundational data structures for search and data systems. Emphasize: cost-model thinking (Big-O of scan/probe/merge, why sequential beats random access), heaps for top-k, external merge sort as THE index-construction primitive, and greedy graph proximity search as the seed of HNSW (taught later in IR 201). Repair a weak DSA base rigorously but efficiently.
